# fivenines_organization (Data Source)

Reads the organization the API key belongs to: identity, effective plan and seat accounting. Readable by any role — unlike the member and invitation endpoints, which need `admin` or `owner`. `seats_remaining` answers "is there room to invite this person" before an invite is attempted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fivenines_organization" "current" {}

output "plan" {
  value = data.fivenines_organization.current.plan
}

# Pre-flight for automated onboarding: an unaccepted invitation holds a seat, so
# check for room before inviting rather than parsing the resulting error.
#
# seats_total is null on an unmetered plan, so it is coalesced rather than
# interpolated directly — a null in a string template is an error on exactly the
# plans that have no cap.
output "seats" {
  value = format(
    "%d/%s used, %d free",
    data.fivenines_organization.current.seats_used,
    coalesce(tostring(data.fivenines_organization.current.seats_total), "unmetered"),
    data.fivenines_organization.current.seats_remaining,
  )
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `display_name` (String) `name` when set, otherwise `slug`.
- `id` (Number) Organization ID.
- `members_count` (Number) Number of members.
- `name` (String) Name of the organization. Null for an organization that has never been named.
- `pending_invitations_count` (Number) Number of invitations sent but not yet accepted.
- `plan` (String) Effective plan — a trialing organization reads as the plan it is trialing.
- `seats_remaining` (Number) Seats still available.
- `seats_total` (Number) Total seats on the plan. Null when the plan is unmetered.
- `seats_used` (Number) Members plus pending invitations — an unaccepted invite holds a seat.
- `slug` (String) Stable URL identifier.
- `trialing` (Boolean) Whether the organization is in a trial.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
